# Voice slot role

<!-- Generated by `loom modules --markdown` from the role descriptor. -->

Plays one note from a pitch, a gate, and a velocity.

ID `loom.role.voice` · Version 1

## Inputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pitch (`pitch`) | pitch | Required | The note's pitch, 0.1 per octave. |
| Gate (`gate`) | gate | Required | High while the note plays. |
| Velocity (`velocity`) | modulation | Optional | How hard the note was played, from 0 to 1. |

## Outputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Out (`out`) | audio | Required | The note's sound. |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Unit | Values | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Level (`level`) |  | Continuous | Optional | How loud the voice is, from 0 to 1. |

## Modules that fill this role

No registered modules fill this role yet.
